row.name: opendray
row.description: Self-hosted gateway for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok Build, OpenCode. Run AI coding agents on your own infra with a shared local-first memory layer. Drive from web, mobile, Telegram / Slack / Discord / Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom. Open REST + WebSocket API. Apache 2.0.
